//! A continuation escape cannot reach backward across an ordinary newline.

use super::powershell::{run, run_clean};

#[test]
fn backtick_only_lines_do_not_bridge_an_ordinary_newline_to_a_pipe() {
    for (name, source) in [
        ("pipe-lf-ordinary-then-backtick-top", "Get-Date
`
| Write-Output
"),
        ("pipe-lf-ordinary-then-backtick-grouped", "(Get-Date
`
| Write-Output)
"),
        ("pipe-lf-ordinary-then-indented-backtick-top", "Get-Date
  `
| Write-Output
"),
        ("pipe-lf-ordinary-then-indented-backtick-grouped", "(Get-Date
  `
| Write-Output)
"),
        ("pipe-lf-ordinary-comment-backtick-top", "Get-Date
# note
`
| Write-Output
"),
        ("pipe-lf-ordinary-comment-backtick-grouped", "(Get-Date
# note
`
| Write-Output)
"),
        ("pipe-lf-ordinary-block-comment-backtick-top", "Get-Date
<# note #>
`
| Write-Output
"),
        ("pipe-lf-ordinary-block-comment-backtick-grouped", "(Get-Date
<# note #>
`
| Write-Output)
"),
        ("pipe-lf-ordinary-two-backticks-top", "Get-Date
`
`
| Write-Output
"),
        ("pipe-lf-ordinary-two-backticks-grouped", "(Get-Date
`
`
| Write-Output)
"),
        ("pipe-lf-ordinary-blank-top", "Get-Date

| Write-Output
"),
        ("pipe-lf-ordinary-blank-grouped", "(Get-Date

| Write-Output)
"),
        ("pipe-crlf-ordinary-then-backtick-top", "Get-Date
`
| Write-Output
"),
        ("pipe-crlf-ordinary-then-backtick-grouped", "(Get-Date
`
| Write-Output)
"),
        ("pipe-crlf-ordinary-then-indented-backtick-top", "Get-Date
  `
| Write-Output
"),
        ("pipe-crlf-ordinary-then-indented-backtick-grouped", "(Get-Date
  `
| Write-Output)
"),
        ("pipe-crlf-ordinary-comment-backtick-top", "Get-Date
# note
`
| Write-Output
"),
        ("pipe-crlf-ordinary-comment-backtick-grouped", "(Get-Date
# note
`
| Write-Output)
"),
        ("pipe-crlf-ordinary-block-comment-backtick-top", "Get-Date
<# note #>
`
| Write-Output
"),
        ("pipe-crlf-ordinary-block-comment-backtick-grouped", "(Get-Date
<# note #>
`
| Write-Output)
"),
        ("pipe-crlf-ordinary-two-backticks-top", "Get-Date
`
`
| Write-Output
"),
        ("pipe-crlf-ordinary-two-backticks-grouped", "(Get-Date
`
`
| Write-Output)
"),
        ("pipe-crlf-ordinary-blank-top", "Get-Date

| Write-Output
"),
        ("pipe-crlf-ordinary-blank-grouped", "(Get-Date

| Write-Output)
"),
    ] {
        assert!(run(source).parse_error.is_some(), "{name}: {source:?}");
    }
}

#[test]
fn adjacent_and_explicit_continuation_pipes_remain_valid() {
    for source in [
        "Get-Date`
| Write-Output
",
        "(Get-Date`
| Write-Output)
",
        "Get-Date`
`
| Write-Output
",
        "(Get-Date`
`
| Write-Output)
",
        "Get-Date
| Write-Output
",
        "(Get-Date
| Write-Output)
",
        "Get-Date
# note
| Write-Output
",
        "(Get-Date
# note
| Write-Output)
",
        "Get-Date`
| Write-Output
",
        "(Get-Date`
| Write-Output)
",
        "Get-Date`
`
| Write-Output
",
        "(Get-Date`
`
| Write-Output)
",
        "Get-Date
| Write-Output
",
        "(Get-Date
| Write-Output)
",
        "Get-Date
# note
| Write-Output
",
        "(Get-Date
# note
| Write-Output)
",
    ] {
        run_clean(source);
    }
}
